Construct a 0x10-byte RenderPass. Stores the geometry/object pointer raw at +0x00, selector at +0x04, bytes at +0x06/+0x07, lightCount at +0x08, and allocates an owned 4*lightCount light-pointer array at +0x0C. Geometry and light objects are not reference-counted; only the pointer array is owned.

Construct a 0x10-byte RenderPass record: selector +0x04, byte +0x06, light count +0x08, light-array pointer +0x0C. Census of 338 direct refs / 46 caller functions found no immediate 0x14E..0x151 producer.
DX11 V180 slot ordering: varargs copied unchanged in increasing index order to the raw light-pointer array at +0x0C, with count byte+0x08. Additive emitters 859160/859430 therefore expose zero-prefix 2/3 point slots; do not compact null/unqualified slots or infer order from light colors.
